text: Power pays only when it crosses a bracket line: near 2.2G each +0.2G moves the 35% reach 3–4 chapters; 328-30 at 35% needs 4.00G.
detail: 35% reach: 304-19 at 2.2G, 308-5 at 2.4G, 317-8 at 3.0G. Moving from the 55% to the 75% bracket is +36% real damage.

text: Stellar Link gives the biggest posted late steps: +13% for opening constellation 8, +10% for its third point.
detail: Free pulls open points up to 8-3; 8-3 → 8-6 takes about 45 cookie stars from paid pulls. Stellar Points only reshape open points.

text: Guild: free to check, unmeasured. The only figure is one reply's ~+20% of account total power for a research-13 guild.
detail: That's 총투력 (account total), not team power, so no stage reach is derived. Leaving a guild dropped one pusher to the 15% cut.

text: Plating is steady but slow: ~414 Chocosteel and 43 Syrup per slot to 15; past 15 each step is a 2–12% roll with shatter risk.
detail: One 14→15 step gave about +1.5% at 1.6G, for ~₩14,700 (1.5 plating packs) or ~4 days of free Chocosteel.

text: Resolve and cookie levels are early-game power; late they barely move the number.
detail: Early a Resolve level was ~1,000 power; late, +200 levels gave Milk ~1k ATK where one gear line gave 6k. Bank coin chests for a 35% line.

text: Free order at 2.2G (the community's): guild and stage-preset padding (free, unmeasured), Stellar points to 8-3 (posted), then lab, weapon plating, oven, Fame, banked Resolve.
detail: The 2G → 4G player credits oven 36, research, Bari 5★, Stellar 8-6. A 4G account: sword 20, bow 19, Resolve 997, Fame 130, lab HP 30%.

text: Paid order (the community's; no package has a posted power figure): Ad Removal, Unique gear pack, Crumble Pass, 5.5 membership, weekly dungeon keys; TSSR stars last.
detail: Ad Removal and Crumble Pass $4.99 (₩7,500) each; weekly keys $3.99 (₩6,000). A pickup TSSR is ~₩289,000 to 5★, ~₩972,000 to 10★.

text: Displayed power is not strength: it weights attack-type cookies and the stats you lack, so pad it for stages and ignore it elsewhere.
detail: Swapping a support for an attacker raises power; an item's power falls once a resistance target is met; accuracy past ~1,000 adds little.

text: Plating and TSSR stars aren't the one road to 4G, and neither ranks above Stellar per won.
detail: The 2G → 4G player has no plate above 18 ('18 2개가 끝임'); the plating 4G accounts also sit at Stellar 8-5 to 8-6 and Resolve ~1,000.

text: Stellar: stop at 95% (10 points) or 91% (8 points), not 100%.
detail: 100% on an old constellation costs 150,000+ Stellar Points expected.

text: Plating: keep Syrup for shatter restores, not shatter mitigation, until about plate 18.
